correctness.rationale: The density is exactly 3(U-yU^3)/(4x0) on the claimed core. Strict positivity of Var(U^3) gives a unique constrained quadratic minimizer, and monotone function covariance gives its positivity. Low-rate exponential-age moment limits reduce to explicit B(k-1,1/2) integrals and yield 21/16, 107/280. Short-time ODE expansion gives U=1-h²Y²/2+h⁴Y⁴/3 and U³=1-3h²Y²/2+7h⁴Y⁴/4. Exact exponential moments Var(Y²)=20, Cov(Y²,Y⁴)=672, Var(Y⁴)=39744 give optimal location correction 28/5 and min-variance constant 12069/20; the high-rate Taylor truncation has exponentially negligible tail. Standalone checker passes independent quadrature and high-precision checks. Finite tests do not establish infinite limits.
